author: priya.raman
body: Please don't add offset pagination (`?page=N&per_page=`) to this list endpoint. We had the ledger entries list skip and duplicate rows under concurrent writes (INC-2231) and spent a week untangling reconciliation. New list endpoints should use opaque cursors, the way ledger-core does for entries. I know it's more work, but we do not want offset pagination on anything that is written to while it is being read.

author: ines.kowalski
body: Fair, I'll switch to a cursor. I'll open a follow-up for the existing /v1/payments list, which still uses offset.

author: priya.raman
body: Approving once the cursor change lands. Pagination rule above is a team standard from now on, not just for this PR.

author: tom.becker
body: Don't log the full recipient address here. Compliance asked us to mask recipient emails and phone numbers in every log line (keep first character and domain). Use the mask helper in platform-libs rather than slicing the string yourself.

author: sofia.alvarez
body: Ack, switching to the helper. I'll grep sender.py for the same pattern.

author: tom.becker
body: We already have IdempotencyStore in platform-libs (added in platform-libs#22). Why a second de-dupe store?

author: sofia.alvarez
body: We need per-channel TTLs and IdempotencyStore only has one global TTL. I planned to converge later once platform-libs supports per-key TTL.

author: tom.becker
body: Merging as a stopgap. Please file the convergence ticket now so this does not live forever.

author: ines.kowalski
body: Approved as a temporary exception to the shared http_client rule: the provider batch endpoint legitimately needs 30s. Remove the direct `requests` usage as soon as http_client supports per-call timeouts.

author: priya.raman
body: Amounts are integer minor units everywhere in ledger-core. Please never introduce float here; the reconcile off-by-one-cent bug in March came from exactly this. If you need to display, convert at the edge.

author: sofia.alvarez
body: The BFF must not retry capture on its own. Capture is only safe to repeat when it carries an idempotency key from IdempotencyStore; otherwise a timeout followed by a retry can double-capture. Pass the key through, and let payments-api decide.

author: tom.becker
body: Agree. Added the key and removed the retry loop.

author: marcus.lee
body: Services should raise platform_libs.errors types, not bare Exception, so the gateway can map them to the shared error envelope. Free-text error messages are not part of the contract.
